observation.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
# confirm ports.json/nginx still consistent
cat .urbo/workspace/ports.json | tr -d ' \n'; echo
grep -oE "172\.[0-9.]+:[0-9]+" .urbo/workspace/nginx.conf | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve --apps=app < /dev/zero' > /tmp/fin-app.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP check $i"; break; }
  sleep 40
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
